name: butylene glycol + glycerin + inonotus obliquus fruiting body
uses: 1. After facial wash, cares the skin texture lightly with toner and take the mask sheet out and unfold it to put on the face to be fit. 2. Leave the sheet about 10~20 minutes and take a rest and remove the sheet and tap the essence left on skin to have it sufficiently absorbed..
otcwarn: 1. For external use only. 1) Do not use over the wound and irritated skin with eczema or infections 2) Discontinue using the product if signs of irritations and/or rashes occur and seek professional medical help 2. Keep the cover closed tight after use 3. Do not put the left over contents back into the container to avoid deterioration 1) Avoid contact with eyes 2) Keep out of reach of children 3) Store in a cool and dry place, away from direct sun light

src.label: BUDDATE INONOTUS OBLIQUUS WATER BRILLIANCE MASK
